items.title: PPL (PPL) Could Be 11% Undervalued On Rate Hike And Data Center Demand
items.summary: Investor attention around PPL (PPL) has sharpened following expectations for third quarter 2026 earnings growth that are tied to a $275 million Pennsylvania rate increase, a $23 billion capital plan, and rising data center power demand.
